artworks.title: Bust of a Man with a Turban Facing Left
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13 x 8.5 cm (5 1/8 x 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of an older man, showing his head and upper torso. He is positioned in profile, looking to the left. His facial features include a long, pointed nose, a pronounced mustache, and a beard. His hair is obscured by a turban that wraps around his head. He is wearing a robe or cloak with folds, and there is an earring in his visible ear. The man also wears a ring on his garments. The background of the image is plain and unadorned, with sketch lines visible.

artworks.title: Maja
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with burnishing on heavy laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body etching of a woman standing with her hands on her hips, slightly turned to the left. She has softly defined facial features, long dark hair, and wears a dress with textured details. A large bow adorns her hair. The background is textured with sketch-like patterns. The artwork is monochromatic, in shades of dark gray and black.

artworks.title: Das Tännengebirge bei Salzburg (The Tännengebirge near Salzburg)
artworks.description: The image depicts an open landscape with mountains in the background. The view is at eye-level, showing a group of people engaged in activities like tending to cattle and gathering near a tall stone structure. In the distance, a range of mountains dominates the horizon. The sky has soft clouds, and the image is in black and white with detailed textures and shading.

artworks.title: In der Ramsau bei Salzburg (In the Ramsau near Salzburg)
artworks.description: This image is a black and white engraving of a mountainous landscape. The scene portrays rugged terrain with a central mountain dominating the composition. In the distance, there are other peaks and hills. On the right side, a small group of people are depicted engaging in activities. The engraving is detailed, showcasing textures of rocks and trees through finely rendered lines. The monochrome palette emphasizes light and shadow contrasts. The sky features clouds and small birds in flight.

artworks.title: Gegend bei Aichen bei Salzburg (The Region near Aichen near Salzburg)
artworks.description: The image displays a pastoral scene with a detailed landscape and buildings. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing an expanse of the landscape with distant mountains and trees. A rustic house with a person at the doorway is surrounded by trees in the center. In the foreground, there is a small herd of cows walking on a path with a figure on horseback. The sky is lightly depicted with birds. The etching technique uses fine lines and hatching for texture. The color palette is mainly greys and blacks typical of monochromatic etchings.

artworks.title: Der König-See gegen den Untersberg bei Salzburg (Königsee toward the Untersberg near Salzburg)
artworks.description: The image shows a lake surrounded by mountains. The horizon is towards the top of the image with mountains meeting the sky. The viewer looks out over the water. A sailboat is on the left side, and a smaller vessel with figures, including a goat, is closer. The style is a detailed sketch with brushstrokes and hatching creating texture and shadow on rocky surfaces and foliage. The palette is monochrome, emphasizing the landscape and the figures' interaction with the environment.

artworks.title: Der Watzmann bei Salzburg (The Watzmann near Salzburg)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a tree in the foreground, a small path, a couple walking with a dog, the horizon, a sky, mountain peaks, and a house. The engraving's brushstrokes are detailed, with fine lines for texture and gradations for depth. The color palette is monochrome.

artworks.title: Der Lattenberg bei Salzburg (The Lattenberg near Salzburg)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a high vantage point. The horizon stretches into the distance, revealing rugged mountainous terrain. In the foreground, a group of people is engaged in daily activities near a stone well or trough. Various tools are scattered around. The brushstrokes create texture in the rocky terrain, foliage, figures, and structures. The color palette is monochrome, with shades of gray typical of engravings. Trees and a small building are depicted on the right side. Rolling hills lead up to the skyline in the background.

artworks.title: Fabriques à Tivoli (Buildings at Tivoli)
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated point of view of a rocky terrain with buildings on a cliff. The horizon is not distinctly visible. The illustration features detailed pencil strokes capturing textures of rock surfaces and foliage. A path leads along the cliff's edge with rocks and vegetation. Various buildings of differing heights and archways are on the cliff's edge. The color palette is grayscale, emphasizing light and shadow. The background shows a gorge with layered rocks, highlighting the height and precariousness of the structures.

artworks.title: Historique du Théâtre de "L'Oeuvre"
artworks.medium: lithograph in green on light brown wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (program closed): 25.3 x 23.6 cm (9 15/16 x 9 5/16 in.)
sheet (program opened): 25.3 x 47.5 cm (9 15/16 x 18 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a close-up portrait of a person's head and neck in profile, facing towards the right side of the frame. The individual has distinct features with a stern or thoughtful expression. Their hair is short, slightly unkempt and dark. The person is depicted in a monochrome sketch style and is wearing a dark garment visible around the neck area. The background consists of a textured surface. Texts are present at the top right and bottom of the image, with the one on top being a quote by Henry Bauer, and the one below noting "Historique du Théâtre de 'L'Œuvre' Saison 1895–96." No visible pieces of jewelry or objects are held by the person.

artworks.title: Le Pont Marie
artworks.description: The image shows a stone bridge spanning across a river, with a cityscape in the background. The bridge is made of large rectangular stones and its arches are reflected in the water. Trees frame parts of the distant buildings. Small boats are tethered near a wooden structure on the water. The color palette is sepia, accentuating the vintage feel and textures of the elements in the scene.

artworks.title: Gravure en Taille Douce: suite de la pl. I
artworks.artist: Antonio Baratta after Benoît-Louis Prévost and A.-J. de Fehrt
artworks.description: The image depicts various tools and instruments for engraving or similar crafts, arranged with labels and measurements. Each tool is labeled with a figure number, showcasing lines, curves, and shapes that illustrate the tools' functions. The tools featured include engraving picks, a round pad, a spoon-like tool, calipers, a compass, a ruler extension, and a small pouring canister. The drawing is detailed and precise, with a technical and instructional appearance.

artworks.title: Gravure en Taille Douce: pl. II
artworks.artist: Antonio Baratta after Benoît-Louis Prévost and A.-J. de Fehrt
artworks.description: The image shows a diagram with labeled figures illustrating various objects. The largest items are a smoking taper marked Fig. 4, and a flat rectangular sheet labeled Fig. 1 and Fig. 2. The color palette is monochromatic in black and white. To the left is the smoking taper with smoke billowing upwards, next to a small bag-shaped object labeled Fig. 3. Below is Fig. 5, a square object on smaller items. On the right are multiple tools, including a pointed stick (Fig. 6), and smaller tools with varying tips. At the bottom middle is a bottle-shaped object labeled Fig. 11.

artworks.title: Gravure en Taille-douce: pl. III
artworks.artist: Antonio Baratta after A.-J. de Fehrt
artworks.description: This is a drawing demonstrating various engraving techniques. It includes figures labeled from 1 to 13 showing different stages and methods used in intaglio printing. The upper part displays outlines and profiles of human heads to illustrate depth creation through incision tools. In the middle, hands are depicted using engraving tools to showcase effective handling techniques. Below, there are diagrams of line and shading effects achieved in engraving, featuring crosshatching and parallel-line patterns. The artwork is annotated with letters and numbers to guide viewers through the engraving process.

artworks.title: Gravure en Taille-Douce: pl. IV
artworks.description: The image contains multiple sections showing different artistic engravings. In the top left and right corners, there are two oval portraits of a person's head and shoulders. The lower left corner features anatomical drawings of an arm and hand with labeled parts. The central section includes another oval portrait, with the subject looking upwards, and in historic attire. The bottom right corner shows a muscular figure poised as though swinging a large club. French text appears below the engravings.

artworks.title: Gravure, Maniere de faire mordre à l'eau-forte: pl. V
artworks.artist: Antonio Baratta after A.-J. de Fehrt
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various equipment and illustrations related to the process of etching. The image features detailed diagrams of different tools and processes used in etching, including a stand with a basin, sheets with intricate patterns, a lush landscape scene, and components like plates, measuring devices, and a box with bottles. Figures labeled from 1 to 7 signify each component or stage, presenting a clear instructional diagram of the etching process with accompanying French descriptions.

artworks.title: Gravure à l'Eau Forte, Machine à Balotter: pl. VI
artworks.artist: French 18th Century, and Denis Diderot, Jacques Renaud Benard
artworks.description: This is a technical illustration featuring components of a mechanical machine. The drawing shows different views and parts of the apparatus, with labels indicating items such as gears, rollers, and levers. The image includes figures detailing the drum, rods, a table, internal mechanisms, crossbars, brackets, a press, and a tray. The drawing is detailed and precise, showcasing the complexity and functionality of the machinery.

artworks.title: Gravure en Maniere Noire: pl. VII
artworks.artist: Antonio Baratta after A.-J. de Fehrt
artworks.medium: engraving, etching, and mezzotint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various engraving tools and techniques used in the "Maniere Noire" or mezzotint process. The drawing shows detailed illustrations of engraving tools numbered as figures 1 through 7, including burnishers and roulettes, which are depicted with precision and labeled with letters indicating parts and possibly instructions for use. Below the tools are geometric grids labeled Fig. 000 and Seconde Fig. 000, showing a grid system with lines and numbers for alignment or scaling purposes. In the bottom right corner is Fig. 9, a small shaded illustration of a sphere inside a box or open-faced cube, showcasing the chiaroscuro effect achievable through the engraving technique. The inscriptions "Gravure en Maniere Noire" and "Pl. VII" suggest this is an educational or instructional plate on mezzotint engraving.

artworks.title: Gravure en Maniere de Crayon: pl. VIII
artworks.artist: Antonio Baratta after A.-J. de Fehrt
artworks.medium: engraving and crayon-manner engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing various engraving tools and techniques. It includes detailed illustrations of tools like styluses, rollers, and other implements used in engraving. The drawings also show textural effects such as cross-hatching and stippling. There are anatomical drawings of the human ear, with contour lines and cross-hatching for depth. Labels and annotations indicate it may be an educational diagram on engraving techniques.

artworks.title: Gravure en Bois, Outils: pl. II
artworks.description: This is an image displaying a variety of woodworking tools. Each tool is labeled with a figure number for systematic organization, likely for instructional purposes. The tools include chisels, drills, calipers, and other devices used in wood engraving. The drawing is intricately detailed, emphasizing the precision and functionality of each tool with lines and shading. The title at the bottom indicates that it is related to wood engraving tools.

artworks.title: Gravure en Bois, Principes: pl. III
artworks.description: This is a drawing of wood engraving techniques. The drawing shows various techniques and examples of wood engraving, with different figures labeled and detailed. It includes multiple carvings and patterns, such as straight and curved lines, grids, and waveforms. Each figure demonstrates a different style or method of engraving on a block of wood. The final figure displays a detailed scene featuring an obelisk and classical architecture.

artworks.title: Imprimerie en Taille Douce, Devéloppement de la Presse: pl. II
artworks.artist: French 18th Century after Robert Benard and Louis-Jacques Goussier
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring detailed components of a printing press. The illustration includes various labeled parts and sectional views of mechanical structures related to a vintage printing press. Each component is shown with precise detail, likely indicating how different pieces fit together or function within the mechanism. The components are numbered and organized neatly across the page, with an emphasis on technical understanding. The etching style and the language used at the bottom ("Imprimerie en Taille Douce, Devéloppement de la Presse") suggest that this diagram serves as an instructional or descriptive guide for the assembly or function of the printing press depicted.

artworks.title: La Belle au bois dormant
artworks.medium: collotype in black on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 12.5 x 22.2 cm (4 15/16 x 8 3/4 in.)
sheet (program closed): 17.2 x 27.5 cm (6 3/4 x 10 13/16 in.)
sheet (program opened): 17.2 x 55 cm (6 3/4 x 21 5/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Martin and Liane W. Atlas
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a theatre program for "La Belle au Bois Dormant." The announcement includes details about the performance, such as the creators and contributors, a quote from Shakespeare, the cast members, and the theater's address. The vintage program showcases elegant typography, offering a glimpse into the theatrical culture of the 1893-94 season at "Théâtre de L'Oeuvre."

artworks.title: Carmosine
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Martin and Liane W. Atlas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatre program for the play "Carmosine." The program features an embossed image on the left side with a figure in a long dress standing in a natural setting with foliage and trees around. On the right side, there is finely printed text listing details of the performance, including the cast, production team, and costume designers. The title "Carmosine," event date (June 10, 1895), and location are prominently displayed. The drawing includes delicate lines, a sophisticated layout, and a vintage aesthetic. The program is signed by Maurice Dumont in red at the bottom right.
